args.summary: The latest deployment v2.3.1 failed health checks in production. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback executed and verified. v2.3.1 is not deployed anywhere in production; root cause of its health-check failures still to be investigated before a new release.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 failed health checks

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: Release history showed the latest deploy **v2.3.1** was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout verified.
3. **Incident opened**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and that root cause of v2.3.1's failures still needs investigation. The on-call engineer has been paged.
